fusions.name: Column Blow
fusions.desc: A blow thrown from the line of march that deals 5 damage, up to 1.4 times as much at 5 tiles. Its damage rises 4% for every 100 paces you have run since you last used it (max 24%).

fusions.name: Phalanx Push
fusions.desc: Shoves everything in a wide cone ahead of you, dealing 12 damage to each and knocking them back 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Marching Order
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 20% for 12 seconds. Your movement speed rises 20% for 5 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Long-Haul Gait
fusions.desc: Your movement speed is permanently increased by 8%, and you have 10% physical resistance.
